title: feuilleea plana
intro: Feuilleea plana, commonly known as the "African Mango" or Irvingia gabonensis, is a plant native to the tropical regions of central and western Africa. It has been traditionally used to support weight loss, improve blood sugar levels, and enhance overall well-being. The health benefits of Feuilleea plana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include irvingol, irvingin, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
